about: Font facts for the fonts the lab cases name, read offline from the installed fonts and the web font fixtures on this Mac. rebuild/lab/font-facts.ts resolves a CSS font declaration to FontFacts per engine from this data (DESIGN.md §1.2). The library never reads it.

machine.note: CTFontCreateForString picks substitutes from the system cascade, which depends on the machine languages recorded here (research reading only).

faceColumns.cssWeight: Core Text kCTFontWeightTrait through Blink ToCSSFontWeight (font_matcher_mac.mm:846-866); ctprobe.swift
faceColumns.coreTextGlyphU2010: CTFontGetGlyphsForCharacters(U+2010); Core Text synthesizes a hyphen glyph for fonts without one (harfbuzz_face.cc:210-220); ctprobe.swift
faceColumns.cmapU2010: best cmap maps U+2010; tables.py (fontTools getBestCmap)
faceColumns.opsz: CTFontCopyVariationAxes has opsz, checked against the fvar table (fvarAxes, tables.py)
faceColumns.morx: CTFontCopyTable morx or mort non-null (what Skia gives HarfBuzz on Apple), checked against the file; ctprobe.swift, tables.py
faceColumns.gsub: CTFontCopyTable GSUB non-null, checked against the file
faceColumns.gsubArabFeatures: GSUB features under script 'arab' (default and every language system); null when there is no GSUB; tables.py
faceColumns.cmapU0628: best cmap maps U+0628 (Arabic coverage); tables.py
faceColumns.pairKerning: where HarfBuzz puts a pair adjustment in Latin text: 'first-advance' (GPOS PairPos XAdvance on the first glyph), 'split' (kern or kerx pair machine: kern >> 1 on the first glyph), null otherwise; from the kerning column of tables.py (GPOS kern scripts and PairPos value formats, kern and kerx subtable formats) and the morx and GSUB columns (build-facts.ts pairKerning)
faceColumns.substituteForU0628: the face CTFontCreateForString(face, U+0628) returns, Blink's system fallback for a character no listed font has (font_cache_mac.mm:127-150, 199-249); ctprobe.swift

realizes.blink: families in list order; a family realizes when a web font of that name is loaded or FontCache matches an installed family (font_fallback_list.cc:149-194). PrimaryFont() looks up U+0020 with should_contain_glyph false (font.h:234-237; font_fallback_list.h:141-145), so the space only selects a unicode-range segment and the primary font is the first realized font (font_fallback_list.cc:88-128). Faces: BestStyleMatchForFamilyNS with BetterChoiceCT, CSS directional weight search (FontFamilyStyleMatchingCTMigration has no status, font_matcher_mac.mm:599-700, 296-360); no-realize falls to -webkit-standard then Times (font_cache_mac.mm:375-392)
realizes.webkit: index-0 family: the first that realizes, else the standard family (FontCascadeFonts.cpp:200-218); faces through findClosestFont's FontSelectionAlgorithm (FontCacheCoreText.cpp:445-538)
realizes.gecko: the first font of the font group; faces by WeightDistance and style distance (gfxFontEntry.cpp:1512)

rules.primaryFamily: the realized family as the list names it; a generic keyword stands for itself (DESIGN.md §1.2)

mapsHyphen.blink: PrimaryFont()->GlyphForCharacter(U+2010) non-zero: HarfBuzz cmap, then SkTypeface::unicharToGlyph through Core Text on Apple (computed_style.cc:1804-1820; harfbuzz_face.cc:210-231): cmapU2010 || coreTextGlyphU2010 != 0
mapsHyphen.webkit: primaryFont().glyphForCharacter(U+2010) non-zero, from CTFontGetGlyphsForCharacters on that font (StyleComputedStyle.cpp:419-435; GlyphPageCoreText.cpp:51-73): coreTextGlyphU2010 != 0
mapsHyphen.gecko: not read by the port (Canvas substitutes as the DOM does, gecko-gaps §3.6); the value is GetFirstValidFont(U+2010) on the primary font, cmapU2010 (gfxTextRun.cpp:2277-2360)

monospace.webkit: Font::determinePitch: kCTFontMonoSpaceTrait, or a non-zero kCTFontFixedAdvanceAttribute, or the full name Osaka-Mono, MS-PGothic or MonotypeCorsiva (FontCoreText.cpp:753-785; specs/webkit-gaps.md §2.1). post.isFixedPitch is recorded per face but not read; Courier has the trait with isFixedPitch 0
monospace.blink: not read (DESIGN.md §1.2); the value follows the FontFacts definition, the WebKit notion
monospace.gecko: not read (DESIGN.md §1.2); the value follows the FontFacts definition, the WebKit notion

rules.opticalSizeAxis: the primary faces have an opsz axis (DESIGN.md §1.2); Blink reads it at layout zoom != 1, Gecko for every run, WebKit not at all

joining.blink: the face drawing U+0628: the first realized font in list order whose cmap maps it, else the primary face's Core Text substitute. 'aat' when it has morx or mort (HarfBuzz applies morx for horizontal text and switches to the dumber shaper, which reads no context: hb-ot-shape.cc:60-66, 100-101; hb-aat-layout.cc:278-282); 'opentype' when it has GSUB with 'arab' init, medi and fina, where the Arabic shaper reads the buffer context (hb-ot-shaper-arabic.cc:305-360); otherwise null
joining.webkit: not read; same value as Blink
joining.gecko: not read; same value as Blink

rules.generics: a generic keyword realizes one of the engine's default families for the script of the text; the lookup takes every candidate below and gives a fact only where all realized candidates agree, else null

blink.source: Chrome defaults for macOS, chrome/app/resources/locale_settings_mac.grd:126-276 (read at chromium-152; the 153.0.8010.48 checkout has no chrome/app/resources), registered for Mac by chrome/browser/ui/prefs/prefs_tab_helper.cc:155-191; Blink asks GenericFontFamilySettings by the font description's script (font_selector.cc:72-89), which falls back to the common script

webkit.source: WebKit Cocoa defaults, UnifiedWebPreferences.yaml:3175-3187 (FixedFontFamily Courier), 7054-7065 (SansSerifFontFamily Helvetica), 7393-7404 (SerifFontFamily Times), 8070-8082 (StandardFontFamily Times); SettingsBaseCocoa.mm:44-50 sets per-script standard families only; FontGenericFamilies.cpp:50-66 falls back to USCRIPT_COMMON

gecko.source: Firefox macOS font.name-list prefs, modules/libpref/init/all.js:2337-2529 (XP_MACOSX), for the language groups of the lab's languages: x-western, x-unicode, ar, he, ja, ko, zh-CN, zh-TW, zh-HK, th, x-devanagari, x-khmr
